theorem backend.rbPartF_agree (γ : backend.BNames) (S S' : GoString → Prop) (r r' : GMap GoString
    backend.BktData) (F F' : GoString → Bool) : backend.rbPartF γ S r F ∗ backend.rbPartF γ S' r' F'
    ⊢ backend.rbPartF γ S r F ∗ backend.rbPartF γ S' r' F' ∗ ⌜(∀ (n : GoString), S n → S' n → r !! n
    = r' !! n) ∧ ∀ (n : GoString), S n → S' n → γ.rbD !! n ≠ none → F n = F' n⌝

    backend.BktData) (S : GoString → Prop) (r' : GMap GoString backend.BktData) : backend.rbSide γ P
    r ∗ backend.rbOwnIn γ S r' ⊢ backend.rbSide γ P r ∗ backend.rbOwnIn γ S r' ∗ ⌜∀ (n : GoString),
    S n → r !! n = r' !! n⌝

    : ⊢ |==> ∃ g, (∃ M, ghostMapAuth g 1 M) ∗ [∗map] n ↦ _u ∈ D, n ↪[g] v n
